stories.headline: Machine Experience (MX) Design Is the New Frontier
stories.dek: Designing for AI agents now matters as much as designing for humans — semantic HTML, labels, and hierarchy need to serve both audiences simultaneously.

stories.headline: Learning Speed Is the New Moat in Product
stories.dek: With AI letting anyone clone workflows in weeks, the real competitive edge is how fast your team notices change, updates beliefs, and ships a different answer.

stories.headline: "Time Saved" Is the North Star Metric of 2026
stories.dek: Friction removal has replaced engagement as the core design goal — if users spend 10 minutes doing a 1-minute task, the product has failed.

stories.headline: Product Explainability: Designing for Human and AI Readers
stories.dek: Strong product explainability ensures AI systems represent your offering accurately without human mediation — a new design layer that's now essential.

stories.headline: Simplicity Wins: Clean UI Outperforms Feature-Heavy Design
stories.dek: Low-visual-noise interfaces with intuitive ergonomics are gaining ground against over-engineered products as users prioritize clarity and speed.

stories.headline: 88% of Researchers Name AI-Assisted Analysis as Top 2026 Trend
stories.dek: AI now handles tagging qualitative data, summarizing transcripts, and generating insight drafts — freeing researchers for higher-level synthesis and strategy.

stories.headline: Research Democratization: Everyone Does UX Now
stories.dek: PMs, designers, and marketers are increasingly owning user research — creating demand for lightweight tools like Maze that run at the speed of product sprints.

stories.headline: UX Research Must Now Speak in Business Terms
stories.dek: The most significant 2026 shift: research teams are being asked to prove value in revenue and retention metrics, not just design quality scores.

stories.headline: Mixed Methods: Combining Qualitative Insight with Behavioral Data
stories.dek: Blending interviews and usability tests with heatmaps and session recordings gives a fuller picture of how users actually behave versus what they say they do.

stories.headline: Visa Launches Intelligent Commerce Connect for AI Agents
stories.dek: AI agents can now browse, select, and pay for goods autonomously — Visa's platform handles tokenization, authentication, and spend controls for agentic commerce.

stories.headline: Gemini 3.1 Adds Real-Time Voice and Image Analysis
stories.dek: Google DeepMind's latest update brings multimodal real-time capabilities, strengthening its position against GPT-5.4's expanded coding and workflow automation tools.

stories.headline: Autodesk Fusion AI Now Writes and Runs Its Own Scripts
stories.dek: The expanded Autodesk Assistant responds to plain-language requests by writing and executing Fusion API scripts directly inside workflows — a leap for design automation.

stories.headline: Startup Poke: AI Agent via SMS and iMessage for Task Automation
stories.dek: New messaging-native AI agent manages scheduling, reminders, and email monitoring — represents the shift toward ambient AI that lives where users already are.

stories.headline: Huawei 950PR Chip Targets AI Inference at Scale
stories.dek: New inference-optimized chip signals continued hardware race to support the surging demand for on-device and edge AI processing outside cloud environments.

stories.headline: AI Energy Use Cut by 100× While Improving Accuracy
stories.dek: Combining neural networks with symbolic reasoning slashes compute cost dramatically — a breakthrough that makes sophisticated AI viable for resource-constrained deployments.

stories.headline: AI Reads Brain MRIs in Seconds, Flags Urgent Cases
stories.dek: University of Michigan system identifies neurological conditions and prioritizes emergencies instantly — directly comparable to AI triage potential in rheumatology imaging.

stories.headline: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T: Robots Follow Natural Language Instructions
stories.dek: Open models enabling robots to understand multi-step NL commands, paired with Cosmos world models for synthetic training data — robotics AI is maturing fast.

stories.headline: Google TurboQuant + MIT CompreSSM: Model Compression Race
stories.dek: Two major compression breakthroughs aim to maximize intelligence-per-parameter, enabling powerful models to run on significantly less hardware and energy.

stories.headline: Neuromorphic Computers Solve Physics Simulations
stories.dek: Brain-inspired chips now handle complex physics equations once requiring supercomputers — a step toward energy-efficient scientific computing at the edge.

stories.headline: NPUs Now Built Into Microcontrollers — Edge AI Goes Mainstream
stories.dek: Chipmakers are integrating Neural Processing Units directly into SoCs, delivering 10–100× better inference efficiency and enabling small LLMs to run locally on low-power devices.

stories.headline: 22 Billion Connected Devices in 2026 — Market Hits $471B
stories.dek: Global IoT device count reaches 22B this year on a trajectory to exceed 40B by 2034, with market value surpassing $471 billion as enterprise adoption accelerates.

stories.headline: Healthcare IoT: Remote Monitoring Reshaping Chronic Care Delivery
stories.dek: Wearable sensors and connected medical equipment enable continuous care outside clinics — directly relevant to rheumatology patient monitoring and product roadmaps.

stories.headline: Predictive Maintenance Market Reaches $28B in 2026
stories.dek: Industrial IoT-driven predictive maintenance grows from $1.5B (2016) to $28B this year, driven by edge sensors, digital twins, and real-time anomaly detection.

stories.headline: Edge AI Achieves Millisecond Response Times, Works Offline
stories.dek: Moving AI from cloud to edge enables real-time decisions at the sensor — critical for privacy-sensitive healthcare applications and latency-critical industrial systems.

stories.headline: AIoT Revolutionizing Crop Monitoring at Scale
stories.dek: Specialized AIoT devices enable large-scale real-time crop health analysis, combining sensor data with AI inference for autonomous agronomic decision-making.

stories.headline: AIoT as the Brain of Industrial Automation in 2026
stories.dek: Traffic management, energy optimization, public safety, and predictive maintenance are all converging on AIoT architectures that combine cloud intelligence with edge action.

stories.headline: Unified Namespace (UNS) Enables Seamless Cross-Device Communication
stories.dek: Widespread adoption of UNS alongside OPC UA and AAS standards is finally breaking down IoT data silos — devices from different makers now interoperate reliably.

stories.headline: Agriculture IoT Market Doubles: $28.65B → $54.38B by 2030
stories.dek: Growing at 10.5% CAGR, smart farming IoT is driven by precision irrigation, drone-sensor integration, and ML-based yield prediction across all major crop regions.

stories.headline: Precision Irrigation Saves 50% More Water vs. Conventional Methods
stories.dek: AI + IoT soil-moisture systems raise crop yields by ~20% while cutting water use in half — carbon credit programs now reward IoT-enabled soil carbon monitoring too.

stories.headline: AI as Conversational Agronomy Assistant — NL Meets Sensor Data
stories.dek: Generative AI interprets complex multi-sensor datasets and delivers plain-language action plans to farmers — the agricultural equivalent of clinical companion approaches.

stories.headline: Solar-Powered Sensor Networks Make Continuous Monitoring Viable on Marginal Land
stories.dek: Renewable energy integration with micro-grids and energy-harvesting modules removes cost barriers for remote IoT deployments in agriculture and energy monitoring.

stories.headline: 296 Product Designer Openings in Barcelona Right Now
stories.dek: Glassdoor lists 296 active product designer positions in Barcelona as of early 2026, with many offering remote/hybrid arrangements — strong hiring momentum in the market.

stories.headline: Proton Hiring Senior Product Designer for B2B Products (Barcelona)
stories.dek: Privacy-focused Proton seeks 5+ years experienced designer for core collaboration features and design systems — strong brand, mission-driven, strong growth trajectory.

stories.headline: Principal & Senior Director of Product Design Roles Active in Spain
stories.dek: Director-level design positions are open at Barcelona-based companies in 2026 — companies include Lodgify, FeverUp, and others; salary range ~€76K+ for senior roles.

stories.headline: Nivoda Seeks Senior Product Designer for B2B 2-Sided Marketplace
stories.dek: 5+ years experience in digital platform design required; focus on UX/UI, user research, and design systems for a high-growth B2B marketplace — strong portfolio opportunity.

stories.headline: The Weird, Twisting Tale of How China Spied on Alysa Liu and Her Dad
stories.dek: Years before the figure skater became an Olympic superstar, a Chinese operative tried to stalk her father and monitored other US residents deemed dissidents against China. And that’s just the beginning.

stories.headline: Who is John Ternus, the incoming Apple CEO?
stories.dek: Starting on September 1, Ternus will lead one of the world's most valuable companies, but if you're not a dedicated Apple enthusiast, you've probably never heard of this man, who has largely remained out of the spotlight until now.

stories.headline: PlayStation’s age-gating restrictions are coming to UK consoles
stories.dek: Sony is starting to comply with the UK's Online Safety Act by notifying PlayStation players of its age verification requirements today.
